required_before_approval: Select and approve source ownership across the Stockinger, Sukhbold, and F23 transition seams.
Select an explicit decay horizon and demonstrate that stable and selected-radioactive source segments can be combined without double counting.
Supply an age-resolved presupernova-wind history or approve and quantify a terminal-lumped approximation.
Define the 8--8.8 Msun terminal-fate policy and the required birth-metallicity domain.
Select an explosion-engine uncertainty model and a canonical event momentum/deposition prescription.
Obtain permission before redistributing MPA archive source data to third parties.
Record a project physics approval identifier.
